blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vessel segmentation is commonly optimized as voxel-wise classification, but small local errors can strongly disrupt vascular connectivity while having little effect on overlap scores. This is particularly problematic for downstream analyzes that rely on centerlines, branches, connected components, or graph structure. We propose a mesh-guided post-processing framework for repairing broken vessel segmentations produced by nnU-Net. For each predicted binary mask, a deformable template mesh is fitted to the mask surface in physical space and used as a case-specific geometric scaffold. The fitted mesh is not voxelized as the final segmentation; instead, it guides conservative reconnection of disconnected components by proposing or validating thin bridge candidates under foreground-growth constraints. We evaluated this approach in three vascular anatomies using AortaSeg24 and SEGA for the aorta, TopCoW for the Circle of Willis, and PARSE for the pulmonary arteries. Performance is measured using Dice, connected-component Dice (ccDice), and the Betti-0 number. Across these datasets, repair substantially improved connectivity while preserving overlap: Dice remained nearly unchanged, whereas ccDice increased from 0.596 to 0.992 for aorta, from 0.722 to 0.835 for TopCoW, and from 0.028 to 0.862 for PARSE. The FOMAML meta-initialization further accelerated the fitting per-case, supporting practical mesh-based repair of the vascular topology. These results suggest that explicit mesh representations can provide a useful geometric prior for correcting topological failures in otherwise accurate voxel segmentations.
blocks.zh: 船只的分化通常作为voxel-wise分类得到优化,但小的局部误差会严重干扰血管连接,同时对重叠分数影响不大. 对于依赖中心线,分支,连接组件,或图结构的下游分析来说,这一点尤其成问题. 我们提出一个网格制导的处理后框架,用于修复NNU-Net公司生产的破碎船段。 对于每个预言的二进制面具,在物理空间的面具表面安装了一个可变形的模板网格,并用作特定大小案的几何脚手架. 装配的网格不作为最后的分块;相反,它通过在前景增长限制下提出或验证薄桥候选人来指导对断开部件的保守重联。 我们用AortaSeg24和SEGA来评估这三种血管解剖方法,用TopCoW来评估Willis圆形,用PARSE来评估肺动脉。 性能用Dice,连接组件Dice(ccDice)和Betti-0数字来测量. 在这些数据集中,在保留重叠的同时,大力改进连接: 水蚤几乎保持不变,而动脉水蚤从0.596增加到0.992,TopCoW从0.722增加到0.835,PARSE从0.028增加到0.862。 FOMAML元初始化进一步加快了每个病例的装配,支持了基于网格的实际修复血管地形. 这些结果表明,明确的网格表示可以提供有用的几何方法,以纠正在其他方面准确的阴道分解方面的地形故障。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Medical image segmentation is often formulated as dense voxel classification [ 21 , 13 ] , yet many target anatomies are more naturally described as geometric objects embedded in physical space [ 10 , 3 ] . Organ boundaries, vascular trees, and anatomical loops are not only sets of foreground voxels. They have surfaces, centerlines, branches, connected components, and topological relationships that determine whether a segmentation is useful for measurement, planning, or modeling [ 15 , 2 ] . This perspective is especially relevant for vascular segmentation, where anatomical shape, branching structure, and connectivity are central to clinical and computational usability. Explicit shape representations, such as surfaces, meshes, or statistical shape models, can complement image-based learning by making anatomical geometry directly accessible to the model and to downstream analysis pipelines [ 25 , 14 , 3 ] . Large-scale resources such as MedShapeNet further facilitate the development and evaluation of methods based on explicit 3D anatomical shape representations [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 医学影像分解常被表述为密集的voxel分类[21,13],然而许多目标解剖更自然地被描述为嵌入物理空间的几何物体[10,3]. 器官边界,血管树,以及解剖环不仅仅是前缘的排骨. 它们具有表层,中心线,分支,连接的元件,以及地形关系,决定一个分块是否对测量,规划,或建模[15,2]有用. 这种观点尤其与血管分化有关,其中解剖形状,分支结构和连通性是临床和计算可用性的核心. 清晰的形状表示,如表面, meshes,或统计形状模型,可以通过使模型和下游分析管道直接获得解剖几何来补充基于图像的学习[25,14,3]. MedShapeNet等大规模资源进一步便利了基于明确的3D解剖形状表达法的方法的开发和评价[16].

blocks.en: The segmentation of vessels exposes this gap particularly clearly. Large vessels and vascular networks are thin, elongated, and strongly anisotropic. Their clinically meaningful properties depend on continuity and branching as much as on local overlap [ 15 , 23 , 6 ] . A small missing bridge can split a vessel into multiple components while changing only a tiny fraction of the volume (see Fig. 1 ). These errors are easy to underweight when optimizing or reporting voxel-wise overlap, but they matter for centerline extraction, branch labeling, diameter measurement, computational flow analysis, and any application that interprets the vascular structure as a connected object or graph [ 19 ] . This has motivated shape-aware approaches that incorporate tubular geometry directly into feature extraction for coronary and cerebral vessel analysis [ 24 ] . Recent vascular benchmarks such as AortaSeg24, SEGA, TopCoW, and PARSE further emphasize that vessel segmentation is not only a regional labeling task, but also a geometric and topological reconstruction problem [ 12 , 26 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 船只的分割特别清楚地暴露了这一差距。 大型的血管和血管网络是薄的,长的,并且强烈的异构性. 它们临床上有意义的特性取决于连续性和分支性,与局部重叠性一样多[15,23,6]. 一个小的缺失桥可以将一个容器分割成多个组件,同时只改变体积的一小部分(见图1). 这些错误在优化或报告阴道重叠时容易被低估,但它们对于中线提取,分支标签,直径测量,计算流分析,以及任何将血管结构解释为连接对象或图[19]的应用都很重要. 这促使人们认识到,将管状几何直接纳入地物提取,用于冠状和脑容器分析[24]。 最近的血管基准,如AortaSeg24、SEGA、TopCoW和PARSE,进一步强调,船舶分割不仅是区域标签工作,而且也是几何和地形重建问题[12、26、17]。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Examples of broken-vessel failure modes across vascular anatomies. Top row: reference vessel structures. Bottom row: broken nnU-Net predictions, with missing local connections highlighted. Such small local errors can fragment otherwise accurate masks.
blocks.zh: 图1:跨血管解剖的断裂血清衰竭模式实例. 上行:参考船体结构. 下行:破损的 nnU-Net 预测,并突出显示缺失的本地连接. 如此小的局部误差可以使口罩碎片化。

blocks.en:
Convolutional segmentation networks have made this problem much more tractable. U-Net established
the encoder-decoder paradigm for biomedical segmentation, and nnU-Net demonstrated how robust configuration choices can turn this paradigm into a strong general-purpose baseline across many medical tasks [ 21 , 13 ] . However, these methods still produce masks on a voxel grid and are commonly trained with losses that primarily reward local agreement with the reference annotation. For tubular structures, high Dice scores can therefore coexist with broken vessels, missing thin branches, isolated false-positive islands, or incorrect loops. Such errors may have limited impact on volumetric overlap while substantially changing the connectivity and topology of the predicted anatomy. This discrepancy motivates evaluation criteria and learning objectives that explicitly account for structure, rather than relying only on voxel-wise agreement.
blocks.zh:
脉冲分裂网络使这个问题更容易被处理。 建立U-Net
“NNU-Net”的编码器-解码器用于生物医学分割的范式,以及“NNU-Net”的演示表明,在很多医疗任务中,稳健的配置选择如何能够将这一范式变成一个强有力的通用基线[21、13]。 然而,这些方法仍然在Voxel网格上产生口罩,并且通常被训练损失主要奖励当地同意的参考注释. 对于管状结构来说,高得分因此可以与断裂的血管,缺失的细枝,孤立的假阳性岛屿或不正确的环共存. 这种错误可能对体积重叠影响有限,同时大大改变预测解剖学的连通性和地形。 这种差异促使评价标准和学习目标明确说明结构,而不是仅仅依赖阴道协议。

blocks.en: The community has responded with topology-aware losses, skeleton-based objectives, and topology-specific evaluation measures. Persistent-homology losses penalize Betti-number errors [ 11 ] , while clDice and centerline-Cross Entropy encourage tubular continuity using skeleton or centerline information [ 23 , 1 ] . On the evaluation side, ccDice extends the Dice principle from voxel overlap to spatially corresponding connected components, making it directly relevant for fragmented vessel predictions [ 22 ] . Recent benchmarking further shows that overlap scores alone do not capture centerline continuity, component structure, and topological correctness [ 6 ] . These works provide important training and evaluation signals, but they do not directly address post-processing of an already available voxel mask, where residual connectivity errors should be corrected while preserving the original prediction as much as possible.
blocks.zh: 社区已经以地貌意识损失、骨架目标以及地貌特征评价措施来应对。 持续热学损失惩罚贝蒂数错误[11],而ClDice和中线-十字环则利用骨架或中线信息鼓励输卵管连续性[23,1]. 在评价方面,ccDice将Dice原则从voxel重叠扩展至空间对应的连接组件,使其与零散的容器预测直接相关[22]. 最近的基准进一步表明,单靠重叠的分数并不能捕捉中心线连续性,组件结构,以及地形正确性[6]. 这些作品提供了重要的培训和评价信号,但是它们并不直接处理已经存在的voxel遮罩的处理后,剩余连接错误应当加以纠正,同时尽可能保留原来的预测.

blocks.en: Mesh representations provide a natural mechanism for such a correction. A mesh is a compact and explicit geometric scaffold: its vertices, edges, and faces encode adjacency, surface smoothness, and allowable paths in continuous physical space [ 4 , 25 , 14 ] . Prior work has used learned mesh deformation to reconstruct anatomical surfaces directly from volumetric images, including Voxel2Mesh and MeshDeformNet-style architectures [ 25 , 14 ] . Related work has also fitted parametric vessel models directly to segmentations, linking voxel, centerline-radius, and mesh representations through differentiable voxelization [ 7 ] . Together, these methods illustrate why meshes are attractive for medical shape analysis: they can reduce staircase artifacts, preserve explicit connectivity, and expose geometry in a form that is easier to regularize than an unconstrained voxel map. However, most mesh-based segmentation methods use the mesh as the final anatomical representation. In vascular segmentation, extensive branching, variable caliber, fine-scale geometry, and substantial inter-patient variability make direct mesh-based replacement challenging. Mesh-deformation models must generalize across both global anatomical variation and small peripheral branches. If the fitted mesh is voxelized as a direct mask replacement, it may overfill the vessel volume or introduce anatomically implausible shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 网格表述为这种修正提供了自然机制。 网格是一种紧凑而明显的几何脚手架:它的顶点,边缘,以及面部编码的辅音,表面光滑度,以及连续物理空间中的允许路径[4,25,14]. 先前的作品利用所学的网状变形直接从体积图像中重建解剖表面,包括Voxel2Mesh和MeshDeformNet风格的建筑[25,14]. 相关工作还直接将参数化容器模型安装到分解上,通过不同的分解分解将阴道、中线射线和网格表示联系起来[7]。 这些方法共同说明了为什么 meshes对医学形状分析有吸引力:它们可以减少楼梯文物,保持明显的连通性,并以比不受约束的voxel地图更容易规范的形式暴露几何. 然而,大多数网基分解方法都使用网基作为最终解剖代表. 在血管分化中,广泛的分支,可变口径,细度几何,以及实质性的患者间变异性,使得直接网基取代具有挑战性. 网格变异模型必须覆盖全球解剖变异和小型外围分支。 如果装配的网格作为直接面罩的替换被氧化,它可能会过度填充容器体积或引入解剖学上不合理的捷径.

blocks.en: Our contributions are fourfold. First, we propose a case-wise deformable-mesh fitting pipeline that transforms an existing nnU-Net vessel mask [ 21 , 13 ] into an explicit, case-specific geometric scaffold. Second, we use the fitted mesh to guide conservative path-based reconnection of disconnected components rather than replacing the mask through full mesh voxelization, thereby limiting unnecessary foreground growth. Third, we introduce FOMAML meta-initialization to accelerate per-case mesh fitting by reducing the required number of optimization steps. Finally, we evaluate the proposed repair framework on four vascular datasets, AortaSeg24, SEGA, PARSE, and TopCoW, using overlap, component-level, and topological metrics that capture the geometric failure modes motivating this work.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有四倍。 首先,我们建议采用一个视具体情况而定的可变形-mesh装配管道,将现有的NNU-Net船罩[21,13]转化为一个明确、针对具体情况的几何脚手架。 其次,我们使用装配的网格来引导保守的基于路径的断开组件重联,而不是通过完全网格的网格化来取代面具,从而限制不必要的前缘生长. 第三,我们采用FOMAML元初始化,通过减少所需的优化步骤数量来加快每个病例的网格配置. 最后,我们利用重叠、构件层面和地形测量方法,评估拟议的四个血管数据集(AortaSeg24、SEGA、PARSE和TopCoW)的修复框架,这些测量方法能够捕捉推动这项工作的几何故障模式。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Pipeline Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 管道概况

blocks.en: The proposed method is a post-processing framework for repairing connectivity errors in vessel segmentations. Given a binary mask predicted by nnU-Net, we fit a deformable template mesh to the predicted vessel surface and use the fitted mesh as a case-specific geometric scaffold. The repaired output remains a voxel mask: the mesh is not used as the final segmentation, but only as a guide for targeted reconnection of disconnected components, as shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 提议的方法是修理船只舱位连接错误的处理后框架。 鉴于NNU-Net预言的二进制面具,我们把可变形模板网格装在预测的容器表面,并使用装配的网格作为具体案件的几何脚手架. 修复后的输出仍为voxel遮罩:网格不作为最后的分块使用,仅作为断开组件定向重联的指南,如图2所示.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Overview of the proposed mesh-guided nnU-Net repair pipeline.
A CT volume is first processed by a CNN segmentation branch based on nnU-Net, producing segmented vessel sections and an initial nnU-Net mask. When the predicted mask is fragmented or topologically inconsistent, its surface is extracted and used as the target for mesh fitting. Then, a fixed template mesh is passed through a GCN deformation branch. The mesh is progressively refined over multiple deformation stages, where each stage predicts bounded vertex offsets and forwards the updated mesh to the next refinement stage. The final overfitted mesh approximates the surface geometry of the nnU-Net prediction while preserving the template mesh connectivity. This fitted mesh is then used as a geometric prior for topology-aware mask repair, producing a repaired nnU-Net mask with improved connectivity.
blocks.zh:
图 2: 拟议的网格制导nU-Net修理管道概述。
一个CT卷首先由CNN分区分支基于nnU-Net进行处理,生产分区船段和最初的nnU-Net面具. 当预测的面具破碎或地形不一致时,其表面被提取出来并作为网格装配的目标. 然后,固定模板网格通过GCN变形分支传递. 网格在多个变形阶段中逐渐完善,每个阶段预测有界顶点抵消,并将更新的网格推进到下一个完善阶段. 最终的超匹配网格在保留模板网格互联互通的同时,大致呈现nU-Net预测的表面几何. 这种装配的网格随后被用作地形感知面罩修复前的几何法,生成一个经过修复的nU-Net面罩,并改进了连接。

blocks.en: 2.2 Datasets and Input Masks
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据集和输入罩

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed repair framework on vascular segmentation datasets covering different anatomical structures and topological regimes. For aortic anatomy, we use SEGA, which focuses on aortic vessel-tree segmentation from CT angiography with emphasis on robustness, visual quality, and downstream meshing, and AortaSeg24, which provides CTA volumes annotated for clinically relevant aortic branches and zones [ 20 , 12 ] . For cerebral vessels, we use TopCoW, a topology-aware Circle of Willis benchmark with voxel-level annotations of multiple CoW vessel components in CTA and MRA [ 26 ] . For pulmonary vessels, we use PARSE, which targets multi-level pulmonary artery segmentation in CTPA scans [ 17 ] . Because the repair task concerns global vessel connectivity rather than multi-class anatomical labeling, all dataset-specific subregions or branch labels were merged into a single foreground vessel label before training and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于血管分裂数据集的拟议修复框架,涵盖不同的解剖结构和地形系统。 对于主动体解剖学,我们使用SEGA,它侧重于CT血管学中的主动体血管-树木分解,强调强健性,视觉质量,以及下游 Meshing,以及AortaSeg24,它提供了CTA卷,注释为临床相关主动体分支和区[20,12]. 对于大脑器皿,我们使用TopCoW,一个具有地貌意识的威利斯圆形基准,上面有CTA和MRA中多个CoW器皿组件的花瓶级说明[26]. 对于肺血管,我们使用PARSE,在CTPA扫描中针对多层次的肺动脉分裂[17]. 由于修复任务涉及全球船只的连通性,而不是多级解剖标签,因此所有数据集专用的次区域或分支标签在培训和评价前被合并为单一的前缘船只标签.

blocks.en: 2.3 Mesh Fitting
blocks.zh: 2.3 网状接合

blocks.en: The mesh-fitting stage of the pipeline is illustrated in Fig. 2 . For each case, we fit a deformable template mesh to the surface of the predicted binary mask. Its associated NIfTI geometry, including voxel spacing, origin, and direction, is preserved so that all fitting operations are performed in physical coordinates. We extract the target surface with marching cubes and convert the resulting vertices from voxel-index coordinates to physical coordinates. To make optimization comparable across cases, the target surface is normalized by the center and scale of its physical bounding box.
blocks.zh: 管道的网格整齐阶段用图2来说明。对于每个案例,我们把一个可变形的模板网格贴在预测的二进制面具表面。 其相关的NIfTI几何学,包括阴道间距,起源和方向得到保存,以便所有适配操作都以物理坐标进行. 我们用行进的立方体提取目标表面,并将由此产生的顶点从voxel-index坐标转换为物理坐标. 为使各案的优化具有可比性,目标表面按其物理边框的中心和规模实现正常化。

blocks.en: The template mesh is deformed toward the normalized target surface using a graph-based mesh decoder. Starting from an anatomy-specific template, the decoder applies a sequence of deformation stages, where each stage predicts bounded vertex offsets conditioned on the current vertex positions and trainable per-vertex features [ 25 , 14 ] . In our experiments, we use a four-stage decoder and optimize its parameters separately for each case. We use a cylindrical template for aortic structures, a spherical template for PARSE, and a torus-like template for the Circle of Willis in TopCoW. The exact template resolution and optimization parameters are reported in the experimental protocol.
blocks.zh: 模板网格变形到正常的目标表面,使用一个基于图表的网格解码器。 从解剖学特有的模板开始,解码器应用了一个变形阶段的序列,其中每个阶段都预测受约束的顶点会以当前顶点位置和可训练的每个顶点特征为条件抵消[25,14]. 在我们的实验中,我们使用一个四级的解码器,并针对每个案例分别优化其参数. 我们使用一个动脉结构的圆柱形模板,一个PARSE的球形模板,和一个TopCoW中威利斯圆圈的类似托鲁斯式模板. 准确的模板分辨率和优化参数在实验协议中报告.

blocks.en: The fitting loss combines Chamfer distance between sampled points on the deformed mesh and the target mask surface with geometric regularization terms, including edge-length, Laplacian, normal-consistency, and face-area regularization. These terms encourage the mesh to follow the predicted vessel surface while avoiding irregular or degenerate deformations. The fitting is performed independently for each predicted mask, rather than training a single mesh model to generalize across patients. For each case, the mesh with the best Chamfer score during optimization is mapped back to the original physical image space and used only as a local geometric prior for the subsequent repair step.
blocks.zh: 配位损失将变形网目上采样点与目标面具表面之间的Chamfer距离与几何规范化术语结合在一起,包括边缘长度,拉普拉西安,正常一致性,面区规范化. 这些术语鼓励网状物跟随预测的容器表面,同时避免不规则或退化的变形. 安装是针对每个预测的面具独立进行的,而不是训练一个单一的网状模型来对患者进行概括. 对于每个案例,在优化过程中拥有最佳Chamfer分数的网格被映射回原始的物理图像空间,并仅用作后续修复步骤之前的局部几何.

blocks.en: Unless stated otherwise, all mesh-fitting experiments used CUDA execution, random target-point sampling, 8192 target points for both the coarse and detail stages, 6000 fitting iterations, a detail-stage learning rate of 0.006, a Chamfer-loss weight of 1.0, decoder-stage maximum offsets of 0.35, 0.20, 0.10, and 0.05, and a decoder-stage auxiliary-loss weight of 0.1. For each dataset, per-case fitting was initialized from a mesh-model checkpoint obtained by overfitting one representative case. Dataset-specific template choices and regularization weights are reported in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,所有网格整形实验均采用CUDA执行,随机目标点采样,粗细级和细细级均采用8192个目标点,6000个装配迭代,细细级学习率为0.006,查姆费尔损耗重1.0,解码器级最大抵消0.35,0.20,0.10和0.05,解码器级辅助损耗重0.1. 对每个数据集,每个案件都从一个网状检查站开始安装,该检查站与一个具有代表性的案件过于吻合。 数据集特定模板选择和规范化权重见表1。

blocks.en: Table 1: Dataset-specific mesh-fitting hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 表1:数据集专用网格适应超参数.

blocks.en: 2.4 Mesh-Guided Connectivity Repair
blocks.zh: 2.4 网格引导连接修复

blocks.en: After fitting, connectivity repair is performed conservatively. Rather than voxelizing the entire fitted mesh, the method identifies disconnected mask components and adds only thin bridge candidates that satisfy geometric validation criteria. To generate these candidate bridges, we consider two complementary strategies: one that follows the connectivity of the fitted mesh graph, and one that proposes local endpoint-to-endpoint bridges validated by the fitted mesh. In the mesh-graph variant, disconnected mask components are anchored to nearby vertices of the fitted mesh, and candidate bridges are obtained as shortest paths on the mesh graph. In the endpoint variant, the method instead proposes short local bridges between nearby component boundary points and uses the fitted mesh only for validation, requiring the bridge to be supported by nearby mesh vertices or face centroids. In both variants, a candidate bridge is rasterized as a thin tube and accepted only if it merges the target components while keeping the number of newly added voxels below a prescribed per-bridge foreground-growth limit.

blocks.en: 2.5 FOMAML Meta-Initialization
blocks.zh: 2.5 多国部队 元启动

blocks.en: Meta-learned initialization has previously been used to accelerate case-specific medical shape reconstruction with implicit neural representations [ 5 ] . Motivated by this approach, we evaluate a first-order model-agnostic meta-learning (FOMAML) initialization for accelerating per-case deformable-mesh fitting [ 9 , 18 ] . Each training case is treated as a separate fitting task. For a given case, surface points sampled from the predicted mask are split into support and query sets. The mesh model is first adapted to the support points using several inner optimization steps, and the shared initialization is then updated using the query loss after adaptation. Following the first-order approximation, the meta-update does not backpropagate through the full inner optimization trajectory. At inference time, the learned initialization is used as a warm start for case-specific mesh fitting, with the goal of reducing optimization time and improving fitting stability.
blocks.zh: Meta-learning初始化之前曾用于加快病例特定医学形状的重建,并带有隐含的神经表达[5]. 在这种方法的推动下,我们评价了一种一阶模型不可知元学习(FOMAML)的初始化,以加速每个病例可变形元的装配[9、18]。 每一个培训案例都被视为一项单独的合适任务。 对于给定的病例,从预测面具中抽取的表面点被分为支持和查询集. 网格模型首先采用若干内在优化步骤来适应支持点,然后在适应后使用查询损失来更新共享初始化. 在一阶近似之后,元更新不会通过全内优化轨迹后卫. 推算时,将所学的初始化作为针对具体案例的网格装配的温暖开端,目的是减少优化时间,提高适配稳定性.

blocks.en: 2.6 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 2.6 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate the repaired masks using both voxel-wise segmentation accuracy and topology-oriented measures. Dice similarity coefficient is used to quantify foreground overlap with the reference segmentation. To assess connected-component consistency, we report ccDice, a topology-aware Dice score that extends the Dice principle from individual voxels to connected components and accounts for their spatial correspondence [ 22 ] . We also report the Betti-0 number, corresponding to the number of connected components in the binary vessel mask, as a direct measure of fragmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们既通过阴道分解精度评估修复的口罩,又采用以地形为导向的措施。 凹槽相似系数用于量化前缘重叠与参考分解. 为了评估连接-组件的一致性,我们报告ccDice,一种地貌-意识-Dice的得分,将Dice原则从单个的Voxel扩展至连接的组件,并核算它们的空间对应[22]. 我们还报告Betti-0编号,对应二进制容器罩中连接部件的数量,作为破碎的直接度量.

blocks.en: Although additional overlap, skeleton, and component-level metrics were computed during analysis, we focus the main results on Dice, ccDice, and Betti-0 because they summarize the central trade-off addressed by the proposed method: preserving voxel-wise segmentation quality while improving vessel connectivity.
blocks.zh: 虽然在分析过程中计算出了更多的重叠、骨架和组件级的度量衡,但我们的主要结果侧重于Dice、ccDice和Betti-0,因为它们总结了拟议方法所处理的中心取舍:在改进船舶连接的同时,保持阴道分离的质量。

blocks.en: 2.7 Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.7 实验议定书

blocks.en: The baseline for all experiments is the raw nnU-Net binary prediction before mesh-guided repair. nnU-Net models were trained using the 3D full-resolution configuration with the default nnUNetTrainer . Training was performed on the Helios PLGrid GPU cluster using one GPU per job, 16 CPU cores, 120 GB RAM, and a 48 h wall-time limit. As summarized in Fig. 2 , the input to the repair stage is a hard binary vessel mask predicted by the nnU-Net 3D full-resolution configuration. The raw nnU-Net prediction is used as the baseline, and the proposed method is applied as a post-processing step to the same mask. We use five-fold outer evaluation protocol, ensuring that each repaired case was segmented by a model that did not see it during training. The repair stage does not use image intensities or nnU-Net probability maps.
blocks.zh: 所有实验的基准都是在网格制导修复前的原始nU-Net二进制预测. nnU-Net模型使用3D全解析配置与默认的nnUNetTrainer 进行了培训. 对Helios PLGrid GPU集群进行了培训,每次工作使用1个GPU、16个CPU核心、120 GB内存和48小时壁时间限制。 如图2概述,对修复阶段的输入是nU-Net3D全解析配置预言的硬二进制容器罩. 原始nU-Net预测作为基线,拟议方法作为处理后步骤用于同一掩码. 我们使用五倍的外部评估程序,确保每个修复的病例被一个在训练期间看不到的模型分割. 修复阶段不使用图像强度或nU-Net概率图.

blocks.en: Mesh fitting and connectivity repair were then run as a post-processing step on the predicted binary masks. These experiments were performed on a local workstation with an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX CPU, 32 GB RAM, and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPU with 24 GB memory. The mesh-fitting hyperparameters were selected by grid-search experiments on the Helios cluster and then fixed for the reported out-of-fold evaluation. All post-processing experiments were implemented in Python using PyTorch for mesh deformation, SimpleITK for NIfTI image I/O and geometry handling, scikit-image for surface extraction, SciPy for connected-component and nearest-neighbor operations, and nnU-Net v2 for baseline segmentation. The source code is available in the accompanying repository [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 然后在预测的二进制口罩上作为处理后步骤运行网格安装和连接修复。 这些实验是在一个本地工作站上进行的,有Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX CPU,32 GB RAM,以及带有24 GB内存的NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPU. 网格整齐的超参数由赫利俄斯星群的网格搜索实验选定,然后固定用于所报告的倍外评价. 所有后处理实验均在Python使用PyTorch进行网格变形,SimpleITK进行NIfTI图像I/O和几何处理,scikit-image进行表面提取,SciPy进行连接组件和近邻操作,nU-Net v2进行基线分割. 源代码见随附寄存器[8].

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Visual Assessment of Vessel Reconnection
blocks.zh: 3.1 船只重新连接的视觉评估

blocks.en: Qualitative examples are shown in Fig. 3 . Broken-connectivity errors were observed across all evaluated anatomies, but with different visual patterns. In the aortic cases, errors typically appeared as small missing bridges along otherwise well-segmented large vessels or near branch regions (Fig. 3 A). The TopCoW cases showed the most frequent local discontinuities in the posterior communicating artery region of the Circle of Willis (Fig. 3 B). In PARSE, the pulmonary arterial tree exhibited severe fragmentation, especially in the thinner peripheral branches (Fig. 3 C).
blocks.zh: 图3显示了定性实例。在所有评估的解剖中都观察到断连接错误,但视觉模式不同。 在主动脉冲情况中,错误一般是沿着原本分明的大型船只或分支区域附近的小桥缺失(图3 A)。 TopCoW病例显示,威利斯环形山后部交流动脉区域(图3 B)的局部断续现象最为频繁. 在PARSE中,肺动脉树表现出严重的分裂,特别是在较薄的外围分支(图3 C)中.

blocks.en: Across these examples, mesh-guided repair added localized connector regions rather than replacing the full mask by a voxelized mesh. The repaired masks therefore preserved the original nnU-Net segmentation in most regions while reconnecting components that were geometrically supported by the fitted mesh (Fig. 3 D-L).
blocks.zh: 在这些例子中,网格制导的修复增加了局部连接器区域,而不是用阴道化的网格代替全面罩. 因此,修复的口罩在大多数地区保留了最初的nnU-Net分区,同时重新连接了由安装的网格(图3 D-L)支持的几何元件。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Qualitative examples of mesh-guided repair across vascular anatomies. The method reconnects fragmented vessel components using local mesh-guided bridges while preserving the original mask away from the repaired regions. Blue arrows indicate broken vessel regions repaired by the proposed method.
blocks.zh: 图3:跨血管解剖的网格制导修复定性实例. 该方法使用局部网格制导桥重新连接破碎的船体部件,同时将原有的面罩保存在远离修复区域的地方. 蓝箭表示用拟议方法修复的船体断裂区域。

blocks.en: 3.2 Effect on Overlap and Connectivity
blocks.zh: 3.2 对重叠和连接的影响

blocks.en: The main quantitative results are summarized in Table 3 . For the aortic cohort, including SEGA and AortaSeg cases, Dice remained essentially unchanged after repair, changing from 0.934 ± 0.043 0.934\pm 0.043 for the raw mask to 0.934 ± 0.043 0.934\pm 0.043 after repair. In contrast, ccDice increased from 0.596 ± 0.275 0.596\pm 0.275 to 0.992 ± 0.057 0.992\pm 0.057 , and the Betti-0 number decreased from 3.35 ± 2.61 3.35\pm 2.61 to 1.01 ± 0.12 1.01\pm 0.12 .

A similar pattern was observed for TopCoW. Dice changed only slightly, from 0.870 ± 0.055 0.870\pm 0.055 to 0.867 ± 0.054 0.867\pm 0.054 , while ccDice improved from 0.722 ± 0.247 0.722\pm 0.247 to 0.835 ± 0.195 0.835\pm 0.195 . The Betti-0 number decreased from 2.58 ± 1.14 2.58\pm 1.14 to 1.02 ± 0.13 1.02\pm 0.13 , indicating that most repaired predictions became nearly single-component structures.

The strongest connectivity effect was observed for PARSE, where raw pulmonary-artery masks were highly fragmented. Dice remained stable, changing from 0.877 ± 0.036 0.877\pm 0.036 to 0.876 ± 0.036 0.876\pm 0.036 , while ccDice increased from 0.028 ± 0.012 0.028\pm 0.012 to 0.862 ± 0.211 0.862\pm 0.211 . The Betti-0 number decreased from 87.46 ± 45.92 87.46\pm 45.92 to 1.56 ± 1.06 1.56\pm 1.06 . The false-branch fraction remained nearly unchanged for the aortic cohort ( 0.056 ± 0.009 0.056\pm 0.009 to 0.055 ± 0.009 0.055\pm 0.009 ) and PARSE ( 0.130 ± 0.020 0.130\pm 0.020 to 0.132 ± 0.020 0.132\pm 0.020 ), but increased for TopCoW from 0.040 ± 0.006 0.040\pm 0.006 to 0.063 ± 0.007 0.063\pm 0.007 , indicating a dataset-specific trade-off between restoring connectivity and avoiding spurious branches. These results support the central motivation of the method: large connectivity improvements can be achieved with negligible change in voxel-wise overlap.
blocks.zh: 观察到PARSE最强的连通效应,生肺动脉口罩高度零碎. 虱子保持稳定,从0.877±0.036 0.877\pm 0.036 改为0.876±0.036 0.876\pm 0.036 ;而ccDice则从0.028±0.012 0.028\pm 0.012 增加到0.862±0.211-0.862/pm 0.211 (英语). 贝蒂-0的编号从87.46±45.92 87.46\pm 45.92下降到1.56±1.06 1.56\pm 1.06. 对主动脉组群(0.056±0.009 0.056\pm 0.009)和PARSE(0.130±0.020 0.130\pm 0.020)来说,假分支部分几乎没有变化,但对于TopCoW来说,则从0.040±0.006 0.040\pm 0.006增加到0.063±0.007,表明恢复连通性与避免假分支之间的数据集特定权衡. 这些结果支持了该方法的中心动机:通过微乎其微的Voxel-wiside重叠变化,可以实现大的连通性改进.

blocks.zh: 表3:修复之前和之后的分块和连接指标。 数值报告为平均±\pm95%的置信间隔. 每个数据集中的最佳值以粗体显示。 FB表示假分支分数.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Quantitative summary of repair effects and mesh-fitting convergence. Mesh-guided repair improves connectivity-oriented metrics while preserving Dice, and meta-initialization accelerates per-case mesh fitting.
blocks.zh: 图 4: 修复效果和网格适应趋同的定量总结. 网格制导修复在保护Dice的同时改进了面向连接的计量标准,元初始化加速了每例网格安装.

blocks.en: 3.3 Effect of FOMAML Meta-Initialization
blocks.zh: 3.3 FOMAML Meta-Initation的影响

blocks.en: One might expect fitting a mesh independently to each predicted mask to introduce substantial computational overhead during inference. To reduce this overhead, we use FOMAML to learn an initialization that can adapt to a new case in fewer optimization steps. Fig. 5 compares Chamfer-loss convergence between standard and FOMAML initialization on 25 held-out TopCoW cases. FOMAML achieved a lower Chamfer loss at every evaluated checkpoint and outperformed the standard initialization in all 25 cases, demonstrating faster and more consistent per-case mesh fitting.
blocks.zh: 人们可能期望将网格独立安装在每个预测的面具上,以便在推论期间引入大量的计算间接费用。 为了减少这种间接费用,我们使用FOMAML来学习一个初始化,可以在更少的优化步骤中适应新情况. 图5比较了25个被搁置的TopCoW案件中标准化和FOMAML初始化之间的Chamfer-loss趋同。 FOMAML在每一个经评价的检查站都取得了较低的Chamfer损失,在所有25个案例中都超过了标准初始化,显示每个病例的网格安装速度更快、更一致。

blocks.en: The largest benefit was observed in the early optimization phase, indicating that FOMAML provides a better starting point for case-wise fitting. After 100 fitting iterations, mean Chamfer decreased from 7.79 × 10 − 4 7.79{\times}10^{-4} with standard initialization to 4.99 × 10 − 4 4.99{\times}10^{-4} with FOMAML. After 500 iterations, the corresponding values were 4.43 × 10 − 4 4.43{\times}10^{-4} and 3.39 × 10 − 4 3.39{\times}10^{-4} . This suggests that FOMAML can reduce the number of iterations needed to reach a given fitting quality, providing a useful warm start for case-specific mesh optimization.
blocks.zh: 在早期优化阶段观察到的最大好处是,FOMAML为个案的适应提供了一个更好的起点。 在100次装配迭代后,Chamfer的平均值从7.79×10 − 4 7.79{\时}10^{-4},标准初始化为4.99×10 -4.99{\时}10^{-4}与FOMAML. 在500次重复之后,相应的数值是:4.43×10 − 4.43{\时}10^{-4}和3.39×10 − 4 3.39{\时}10^{-4}. 这表明FOMAML可以减少达到特定适配质量所需的迭代次数,为针对具体案例的网格优化提供有用的温暖开端.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Effect of FOMAML meta-initialization on per-case mesh-fitting convergence for 25 held-out TopCoW cases. Lines show mean Chamfer loss across cases, and shaded regions indicate ± \pm SEM. The black horizontal line indicates a matched Chamfer-distance level, allowing comparison of the number of optimization steps required by FOMAML and standard initialization to reach the same reconstruction error.
blocks.zh: 图5:FOMAML meta-初始化对25个被搁置的TopCoW案例的每个案件网格组合的影响。 线条显示的是Chamfer在各种情况下的损失,而阴影区域表示±\pm SEM. 黑色水平线表示一个匹配的Chamfer-距离级别,可以比较FOMAML和标准初始化所需的优化步骤数量,以达到相同的重建错误.

blocks.en: Overall, the results show that the proposed repair strategy mainly affects connectivity rather than regional overlap. This behavior is desirable for broken-vessel repair: the method improves component structure and connectedness while preserving the strong voxel-wise segmentation performance of nnU-Net.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,结果显示,拟议的修理战略主要影响连通性,而不是区域重叠。 这种行为对于断流器修复来说是可取的:这种方法提高了组件结构和连接性,同时保留了nnU-Net的强Voxel-wiseal分解性能.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Mesh-Guided Topology Repair
blocks.zh: 4.1 网格指导地形修复

blocks.en: The results indicate that mesh representations can be useful as case-specific geometric priors for repairing vessel topology. Instead of replacing a voxel segmentation with a fully voxelized mesh, the proposed method uses the fitted mesh only to guide local reconnection. This distinction is important: the repaired output remains close to the original nnU-Net prediction, while the mesh provides additional geometric structure for identifying plausible paths between fragmented components. Because the mesh is fitted independently for each case, the method does not require a single mesh model to generalize directly across all patients and vascular anatomies. This per-case optimization is especially useful for vessels, where branching patterns, caliber, and topology vary substantially between cases. Across datasets, the main effect of the method was therefore observed in connectivity-sensitive metrics, whereas Dice changed only marginally.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,网格表示可作为具体案例的几何前缀,用于修复船只地形。 提议的方法不是用全阴极化的网格来取代阴极分化,而是使用装配的网格来指导局部重联. 这种区分很重要:修复的输出仍然接近于最初的nnU-Net预测,而网格则提供了额外的几何结构,用于识别碎裂组件之间的可信路径. 由于网格是独立为每个病例安装的,因此这种方法不需要一个单一的网格模型直接概括到所有患者和血管解剖中. 这种个案优化对船只特别有用,因为船只的分枝模式、口径和地形因情况而异。 因此,在整个数据集中,在对连通性敏感的计量中观察到了该方法的主要效果,而Dice仅略有变化。

blocks.en: The behavior was most consistent for aortic anatomy, where the target structure is comparatively large and the main connectivity errors are often localized. TopCoW and PARSE introduce more challenging topological settings. In the Circle of Willis, small vessels, variable anatomy, and clinically important communicating arteries mean that a local discontinuity can strongly affect graph connectivity. Moreover, some TopCoW ground-truth masks represent anatomically incomplete Circle of Willis variants; for example, absence of both posterior communicating arteries may leave the anterior and posterior circulations disconnected in the binary vascular mask [ 26 ] . PARSE is also demanding because pulmonary arteries form a dense, highly branching tree with many peripheral vessels. In these cases, mesh fitting and bridge selection must handle substantially more complex geometry than in the aorta.
blocks.zh: 这种行为对于主动解剖学来说是最一致的,在那里,目标结构相对大,主要的连接错误常常是局部的. TopCoW和PARSE引入了更具挑战性的地形环境. 在威利斯圆圈中,小器皿,可变解剖学,以及临床上重要的交流动脉,意味着局部的不连续性会强烈地影响图的连接. 此外,一些TopCoW地面真实口罩代表了解剖学上不完整的威利斯变体;例如,缺乏后动脉的交流可能使二进制血管口罩中前部和后部的循环断开[26]. PARSE也是要求的,因为肺动脉与许多外围血管形成密密,高度分支的树. 在这些情况下,网格配置和桥梁选择必须处理比主动脉要复杂的几何学。

blocks.en: The FOMAML meta-initialization further improves the practicality of this per-case strategy. In the aortic setting, nnU-Net inference required 44.17 s per case, while FOMAML-initialized mesh fitting with approximately 300 optimization steps followed by post-repair required about 30 s per case. Thus, the additional geometric repair stage remains comparable to the original segmentation inference time while providing a targeted improvement in connectivity.
blocks.zh: FOMAML元初始化进一步提高了这种逐例策略的实用性. 在主动脉动环境下,nU-Net推论每例需要44.17s,而FOMAML初始网格装配约300个优化步骤,后期修复每例需要约30s. 因此,额外的几何修复阶段仍然与最初的分解推断时间相当,同时有针对性地改进连接。

blocks.en: 4.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.2 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations remain. First, the fitted mesh can support an incorrect bridge if the mask contains misleading false-positive components or if the mesh deformation follows an anatomically implausible shortcut. Second, although optional component filtering and mesh-supported cleanup reduce the influence of distant false positives, they do not fully solve cases where false positives are close to true vessels. Third, the current repair stage uses hard binary masks and does not exploit image intensities or nnU-Net probability maps, which could help distinguish plausible missing vessels from unsupported bridges. Finally, the method relies on dataset-specific templates and hyperparameters, which may need adjustment for new vascular territories.
blocks.zh: 仍然存在若干限制。 首先,安装的网格可以支持一个错误的桥段,如果面具含有误导性的假阳性成分,或者如果网格变形遵循解剖学上不合理的捷径. 第二,虽然可选的组件过滤和网格支持的清理降低了远处假阳性的影响,但是它们并不能完全解决假阳性接近真血管的情况. 第三,目前的修复阶段使用硬二进制口罩,不利用图像强度图或nnU-Net概率图,这可能有助于区分假想缺失的舰只和无支撑的桥梁. 最后,该方法依赖于数据集特有的模板和超参数,这些模板和参数可能需要调整新的血管领域.

blocks.en: 4.3 Future Work
blocks.zh: 4.3 今后的工作

blocks.en: Future work will focus on making the repair step more adaptive. Learned bridge scoring could replace hand-designed acceptance rules, while anatomical constraints could reduce implausible shortcuts in highly variable structures such as the Circle of Willis and pulmonary vasculature. Incorporating probability maps or image-based evidence may also improve bridge validation, especially in ambiguous peripheral regions. We also plan to conduct computational hemodynamic experiments to quantify how small topological corrections affect simulated blood flow and other downstream functional measurements. More broadly, combining per-case mesh fitting with learned topology-aware repair may provide a stronger framework for correcting vascular segmentation without retraining the original segmentation model.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于使修复步骤更具适应性。 学得的桥分可以取代手工设计的验收规则,而解剖限制可以减少极易变异的结构如威利斯圆圈和肺蒸发的捷径. 纳入概率图或基于图像的证据也可改进桥梁验证,特别是在模棱两可的外围区域。 我们还计划进行计算血动力学实验,量化小的地形矫正如何影响模拟血流和其他下游功能测量. 更广泛地说,将每个病例的网格与学会的地形意识修复结合起来,可以为纠正血管分裂提供更强有力的框架,而无需再培训最初的分裂模式。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented a mesh-guided post-processing method for repairing broken vessel segmentations. By fitting a deformable mesh to each predicted mask and using it as a local geometric scaffold, the method improves vascular connectivity while preserving the original voxel-wise segmentation. With FOMAML initialization, the per-case repair remains practical in runtime while avoiding the need for a globally generalizing mesh prediction model. The results support the use of mesh representations as practical geometric priors for topology repair in vessel segmentation.
